objective.text: Stop ordinary listener propagation when a listener returns false.

difficulty.rationale: Track a false return separately from an exception or an ordinary null return.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.source:
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;

Event::listen('report.ready', function () {
    echo 'A';

    return false;
});

Event::listen('report.ready', function () {
    echo 'B';
});

Event::dispatch('report.ready');

stem: Listeners are registered only in this order. What is printed?

options.rationale: Returning false is supported propagation control, not itself an exception.

options.rationale: Ordinary propagation does not continue past this false response.

options.rationale: The first listener runs before its return value can affect propagation.
